newsitem.title: USA: TVA says Browns Ferry 3 at 90 pct power.
newsitem.headline: TVA says Browns Ferry 3 at 90 pct power.

text.p: Tennessee Valley Authority's (TVA) Browns Ferry 3 nuclear power unit reached 90 percent of its 1,065 megawatt (MW) capacity earlier today after being restarted Tuesday, the company said Wednesday.
The unit, in Decatur, Ala., was shut Sunday because of an electrical fault in its recirculation pump's motor generator.
The utility would raise the output of the unit when it is satisfied with the positions of the reactor's control rods, said TVA spokesman Terry Johnson.
Control rods regulate the fission process in the reactor.
Johnson said the positions of the rods would be changed before the unit would resume full output.
"It's a normal procedure," he said, referring to adjustment of the rods during startup.
